children: Reaffirms Full-Year 2026 Outlook
Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results to be Reported on October 30, 2026
MESA, Ariz., Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Verra Mobility Corporation (

), a leading provider of smart mobility technology solutions, today announced that Craig Conti will step down as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer to pursue a role at a private company outside of Verra Mobility's industry, effective November 4, 2026.

The Board has begun a comprehensive search process with the assistance of a leading executive search firm, Spencer Stuart, to fill the CFO position on a permanent basis. Verra Mobility expects to appoint an interim CFO.

"I am grateful for Craig's leadership, partnership and contributions to the Company," said Jon Keyser, Interim President and CEO of Verra Mobility. "On behalf of all of us at Verra Mobility, I wish him well in his next chapter."

Mr. Conti's departure is not related to the Company's financial or operating results or to any disagreements with the Company regarding its financial, operational, accounting or reporting policies or practices.
In addition, the Company is reaffirming the 2026 full-year outlook it presented on August 5, 2026.
Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results & Full-Year 2026 Outlook

Verra Mobility will report its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 before market open on October 30, 2026. Given the pending leadership transitions, Verra Mobility does not intend to hold a conference call in connection with the release of its third quarter financial results. The Company expects to resume its customary quarterly earnings conference calls beginning with its fourth quarter and full-year 2026 results.
About
Verra Mobility
Verra Mobility Corporation (

) is a leading provider of smart mobility technology solutions that make transportation safer, smarter and more connected. The company sits at the center of the mobility ecosystem, bringing together vehicles, hardware, software, data and people to enable safe, efficient solutions for customers globally. Verra Mobility's transportation safety systems and parking management solutions protect lives, improve urban and motorway mobility and support healthier communities. The company also solves complex payment, utilization and compliance challenges for fleet owners and rental car companies. Headquartered in Arizona, Verra Mobility operates in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia. For more information, please visit
